elements.quote: We performed this study to summarize the evidence about the use of SB in patients with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA).
elements.reason: The abstract clearly frames the study as summarizing evidence (systematic review/meta-analysis context).

elements.quote: We performed this study to summarize the evidence about the use of SB in patients with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA).
elements.reason: An explicit main objective is stated in the Methods/Background portion of the abstract.

elements.quote: Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, EBSCO, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library, until June 2019, for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies that used SB in patients with OHCA.
elements.reason: The abstract specifies study design and population for inclusion (RCTs/observational; patients with OHCA) but does not explicitly state main exclusion criteria.

elements.quote: Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, EBSCO, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library, until June 2019, for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies that used SB in patients with OHCA.
elements.reason: Information sources (databases) and the search time limit (until June 2019) are explicitly reported.
No methods for assessing risk of bias in included studies are reported in the provided abstract text.

elements.quote: Odds ratio (OR) with their 95% confidence interval (CI) were pooled in a random or fixed meta-analysis model.
elements.reason: The abstract states the statistical approach used to present and synthesize results (pooled ORs; random or fixed effects model).

elements.quote: Results: A total of 14 studies (four RCTs and 10 observational studies) enrolling 28,412 patients were included; of them, eight studies were included in the meta-analysis.
elements.reason: The abstract reports the number of included studies and participants and summarizes relevant study characteristics (study designs).

elements.quote: The overall pooled estimate did not favor SB or control in terms of survival rate at discharge (OR= 0.66, 95% CI [0.18, 2.44], p =0.53) and ROSC rate (OR= 1.54, 95% CI [0.38, 6.27], p =0.54), while the pooled estimate of two studies showed that SB was associated with less sustained ROSC (OR= 0.27, 95% CI [0.07, 0.98], p =0.045) and good neurological outcomes at discharge (OR= 0.12, 95% CI [0.09, 0.15], p <0.01).
elements.reason: Main outcomes are reported with pooled estimates (including number of studies for some outcomes) and confidence intervals.

elements.quote: Odds ratio (OR) with their 95% confidence interval (CI) were pooled in a random or fixed meta-analysis model. ... survival rate at discharge (OR= 0.66, 95% CI [0.18, 2.44] ...); ROSC rate (OR= 1.54, 95% CI [0.38, 6.27] ...); ... sustained ROSC (OR= 0.27, 95% CI [0.07, 0.98] ...); ... good neurological outcomes at discharge (OR= 0.12, 95% CI [0.09, 0.15] ...).
elements.reason: Because a meta-analysis was conducted, the abstract provides summary estimates (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals for main outcomes.

elements.quote: The overall pooled estimate did not favor SB or control in terms of survival rate at discharge ... and ROSC rate ... while the pooled estimate of two studies showed that SB was associated with less sustained ROSC ... and good neurological outcomes at discharge ...
elements.reason: The abstract indicates the direction of effect and which group is favored (no favoring for survival/ROSC; SB associated with worse outcomes, implying control is favored for those outcomes).
No brief limitations of the included evidence (e.g., risk of bias, inconsistency, imprecision) are reported in the provided abstract text.

elements.quote: Conclusion: The current evidence demonstrated that SB was not superior to the control group in terms of survival to discharge and return of spontaneous circulation. Further, SB was associated with lower rates of sustained ROSC and good neurological outcomes.
elements.reason: The abstract provides an interpretation of results and key implications.
The abstract does not report the primary source of funding for the review.
The abstract does not provide a trial/protocol register name and registration number.
